title_en: No conditions were discussed with India regarding Sheikh Hasina, says State Minister for Foreign Affairs

summary_en: Bangladesh's State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid said that the Bangladesh government has not discussed any conditions with India regarding Sheikh Hasina. On the other hand, the Election Commission of Bangladesh has announced that it has finalized the plan for the country's Union Parishad elections in five phases.
